about_the_game:
Step into the world of BLACKWOOD, a gritty third-person action thriller that blends smooth, responsive combat with cinematic storytelling.

By day, you are a seemingly ordinary store owner, managing your small DVD shop in an authentic recreation of New York, 2012. When night falls, you descend into the city’s underworld as a contract killer, caught between survival, morality, and a past that refuses to stay buried.

One Epic Story Told In Three Parts.

Anton's story takes place over the course of three Acts. Each Act is a complete part of the overall story, with new missions added in between the major acts.

Current Act Roadmap:

  • Act 1: September 16, 2026

  • Act 2: March 2027

  • Act 3: September 2027

When you purchase BLACKWOOD, you are purchasing the full game. All future acts will be provided as free updates to existing owners. If you buy BLACKWOOD at launch, you will not need to purchase Act 2 or Act 3 separately.

Act One Coming September 16, 2026.

FIGHT YOUR WAY THROUGH THE CITY

Gunplay is fast, stylish, and unforgiving. Keep the Action relentless with fluid movement options like dives, rolls, and slides. Every encounter feels cinematic yet responsive, giving you the freedom to create your own moments of chaos.

MASTER BRUTAL TAKEDOWNS

BLACKWOOD’s signature mechanic: countless contextual takedowns. From one-on-one hand-to-hand executions to using the environment around you, every fight is an opportunity to end your enemies with precision and style. Grounded, weighty, and satisfying to master.

A DOUBLE LIFE TO BALANCE

Your store is more than just a front. It's where you live, decorate, and roleplay a “normal” existence. Buy and sell DVDs, change outfits, interact with your apartment, and explore RPG elements that make your dual identity feel tangible. The contrast between day and night defines the world and the choices you make.

CINEMATIC STORYTELLING

BLACKWOOD introduces a cast of flawed, human characters navigating a violent city full of secrets. Every ad, tattoo, and poster tells a story. Every mission pulls you deeper into a web of conspiracies and consequences.

STORE MANAGEMENT

Take control of your DVD shop and decide how hands-on you want to be. Restock shelves, organize inventory, set prices, and jump in at the counter to keep profits high. Let it run on autopilot, and you will get by. Manage it smartly, and you can watch it turn into a powerful source of income
requirements_minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 / Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 3600 / Intel Core i5-10400F
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1650 / AMD Radeon RX 570 / Intel Arc A380
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 30 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: 1080p Low settings, 30 FPS at native resolution. SSD required. FSR2 available as an optional performance mode.
requirements_recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 / Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 5600X / Intel Core i5-12400F
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3060 / AMD Radeon RX 6600 XT / Intel Arc A750
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 30 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: 1080p High settings, 60 FPS at native resolution. SSD required; NVMe SSD recommended. DLSS/FSR2 available for higher resolutions or additional performance headroom. DirectX 12 is optional on supported hardware for improved PSO stability.
